public.public_event_inventory.definition:
SELECT id,
    title,
    slug,
    short_description,
    description,
    start_at,
    end_at,
    timezone,
    location,
    room,
    type,
    level,
    image_url,
    image_media_id,
    event_link,
    registration_url,
    google_form_url,
    google_event_url,
    registration_type,
    registration_enabled,
    max_participants,
    is_featured,
    prerequisites,
    what_youll_learn,
    what_to_bring,
    schedule,
    additional_info,
    contact_info,
    publication_status,
    published_at,
    updated_at,
    created_at,
    revision,
    registration_state,
        CASE registration_state
            WHEN 'open'::text THEN 0
            WHEN 'full'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'closed'::text THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS registration_priority
   FROM ( SELECT e.id,
            e.title,
            e.slug,
            e.short_description,
            e.description,
            e.start_at,
            e.end_at,
            e.timezone,
            e.location,
            e.room,
            e.type,
            e.level,
            e.image_url,
            e.image_media_id,
            e.event_link,
            e.registration_url,
            e.google_form_url,
            e.google_event_url,
            e.registration_type,
            e.registration_enabled,
            e.max_participants,
            e.is_featured,
            e.prerequisites,
            e.what_youll_learn,
            e.what_to_bring,
            e.schedule,
            e.additional_info,
            e.contact_info,
            e.publication_status,
            e.published_at,
            e.updated_at,
            e.created_at,
            e.revision,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT e.registration_enabled THEN 'closed'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(e.end_at, e.start_at) <= now() THEN 'ended'::text
                    WHEN e.max_participants IS NOT NULL AND (a.internal_count + e.external_attendees) >= e.max_participants THEN 'full'::text
                    ELSE 'open'::text
                END AS registration_state
           FROM events e
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS internal_count
                   FROM event_attendance r
                  WHERE r.event_id = e.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.max_participants IS NOT NULL AND e.registration_enabled AND COALESCE(e.end_at, e.start_at) > now()) a ON true
          WHERE e.publication_status = 'published'::text) inventory;
